requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with Increased Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new generation (NGB) keyed ink bottles supporting 6,000-page yield for Black and 6,000-page yield for CMY, with CMY bottle size supporting >8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Higher yield reduces customer intervention and supports market demand for longer-lasting consumables.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink formulation compatibility, bottle design, IDS integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NGB bottles are available and pass page yield tests: 6K for Black, 6K (min) for CMY, with CMY size supporting >8K pages. Bottles must be keyed to prevent incorrect installation.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure that new ink bottles and tank integration deliver spill-free operation during installation and refilling.
requirements.Rationale: Spill-free operation is critical for customer satisfaction and to reduce warranty/service costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle and tank interface design, IDS system
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles and tanks pass spill-free reliability tests under all use conditions defined in the test plan.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Implement NOA-F (Next-Gen Output Assembly-Filter) with a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, with no change to click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhanced filtration and product differentiation, while maintaining compatibility with existing mechanisms.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F design, existing push-push and TDF compatibility
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F assemblies pass functional and reliability validation, and are compatible with existing mechanisms.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Superamp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Inks
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Superamp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks without reformulation for Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development time and cost, ensures proven performance.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new bottle/tank system, supply chain alignment
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink reformulation required; Superamp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie inks perform to existing specifications in Magellan system.

requirements.Title: Reliability, WVTR, Air Gain, Flow Rate, IDS Characterization
requirements.Description: Model and characterize reliability, water vapor transmission rate (WVTR), air gain, flow rate, and IDS (Ink Delivery System) for startup and NOA-F end-of-life (EOL).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures system robustness and supports warranty claims.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Complete reliability and IDS models; pass defined reliability, WVTR, air gain, and flow rate tests for startup and NOA-F EOL.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modeling
requirements.Description: Develop and validate ink stability modeling for tank storage and its impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: Critical to ensure long-term ink stability and consistent print quality over product life.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink chemistry, tank material, environmental testing
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink stability model is documented and validated; PQ meets defined standards after long-term storage in tank.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Parts in Warranty Support
requirements.Description: NOA-F to be available as service parts for warranty support.
requirements.Rationale: Enables effective field service and warranty fulfillment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F is listed as a service part and available within warranty support channels.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 (presumed security/ID feature) on the lid of the product.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances product security and traceability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 is integrated and functional on all production lids.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and Magi Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify SA14 line for NOA-F, add Magi ink cart and labelling tool in Orcus 5. Mold 1-4 new keyed caps.
requirements.Rationale: Factory readiness for new components and processes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SA14 and Orcus 5 lines are modified and validated for production of NOA-F and Magi ink carts, new caps in place.

requirements.Title: Support Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design PHA (Printhead Assembly) and NOA-F to be customer-replaceable.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and reduces downtime/costs for users and support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PHA and NOA-F can be replaced by customers following provided instructions, with no tools or minimal tools required.

requirements.Title: New Warranty Page Life Goal of 80K Pages
requirements.Description: Set and support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages for the product.
requirements.Rationale: Meets market expectations for reliability and reduces warranty costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes reliability testing for 80,000 pages without major failure.

requirements.Title: Size Increase for Tank (Reddington ID)
requirements.Description: Increase tank size to support higher ink volumes, with no change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher yield bottles and longer intervals between refills.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tank volume increased to specified capacity; product passes all fit and function tests.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam for product packaging.
requirements.Rationale: Protects product during shipping and handling; aligns with packaging standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All shipped products use EPS foam packaging and pass drop/impact tests.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, Blue Angel Certification (for PDL SKU)
requirements.Description: Ensure product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental certification for the PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Required for market access and sustainability goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU is certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel.

requirements.Title: Input and Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to accommodate tank protrusion and optimize size.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical compatibility and optimal footprint.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays fit and function with new tank design; product passes paper path and handling tests.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch color graphical display (CGD) into the product.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user interface and control.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product ships with 4.3” CGD display, and all UI functions are accessible and testable.

requirements.Title: Platform with 4 Tubes and Sayan Sibstar Tube Routing
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes with new routing and integration into the ink delivery platform (4 tubes).
requirements.Rationale: Supports multi-color ink delivery and reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System uses 4 Sayan Sibstar tubes with validated routing and integration.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station aerosol management and spit platform to accommodate tank changes.
requirements.Rationale: Maintains printhead reliability and cleanliness with new tank configuration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service station passes aerosol containment and cleaning tests with new tank.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Modeling for New Tubes/Weights
requirements.Description: Model carriage dynamics and forces considering new tube routing and increased weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical reliability and print quality.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage system passes dynamic and force validation tests.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Update paper path design to support increased page life requirement (80K pages).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable operation over extended product life.
requirements.Dependencies: Paper path component durability, reliability testing
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path passes reliability test for 80,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as Serviceable Part Post-80K Life
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance module as a serviceable part at service centers after 80,000-page life.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces total cost of ownership and supports product longevity.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance module can be replaced at service center after 80K pages; process documented.

requirements.Title: 140ml Black and New CMY Bottle Sizes
requirements.Description: Introduce 140ml black bottles and new CMY bottle sizes (volume TBD).
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with increased yield and market expectations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 140ml black and new CMY bottles are available and meet page yield targets.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and fluidic interconnect (FI) connection for the Ink Delivery System (IDS).
requirements.Rationale: Improves system reliability and serviceability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS passes make-break and FI connection tests as per design specs.

requirements.Title: LEBI Ink-Tank with Increased Size, Keying, and LOI SHAID
requirements.Description: Leverage LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and single SHAID (security/authentication ID).
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher yield, prevents misinstallation, and enhances security.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: LEBI ink-tank meets size, keying, and SHAID requirements; passes validation tests.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new startup algorithm and air management system for IDS.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable startup and prevents air ingestion issues.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS startup and air management validated in system testing.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Hi PDL for WS
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Hi PDL (Print Description Language) for WS (Workstation).
requirements.Rationale: Leverages proven technology and reduces development effort.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Marconi Hi PDL is functional in the new WS context.

requirements.Title: New Servicing and Startup Algorithm
requirements.Description: Develop new servicing and startup algorithm to support new hardware and consumables.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable operation and user experience with new components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Servicing and startup algorithm validated in end-to-end system testing.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality (PQ) Goals and Depletion Definition
requirements.Description: Define new print quality goals and depletion metrics to align with new page yield definitions.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures print quality is maintained throughout consumable life.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ metrics and depletion definitions are documented and validated in testing.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU for the new platform.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces hardware development time and leverages proven components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All reused components pass integration and system tests.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module for wireless connectivity.
requirements.Rationale: Enables wireless printing and network integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi module is integrated and passes wireless functionality tests.

requirements.Title: FW Dune Platform Usage
requirements.Description: Use FW Dune firmware platform for the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Standardizes firmware and leverages existing ecosystem.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: FW Dune is operational on the Magellan platform.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security features in both hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: Meets security requirements for enterprise and SMB markets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Gauss4.xx security features pass security validation and penetration tests.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS and WorkFromHome/Flexworker Services
requirements.Description: Enable support for Print-as-a-Service (PaaS) and WorkFromHome/Flexworker service models.
requirements.Rationale: Expands business model and addresses changing work environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS and WorkFromHome/Flexworker features are available and functional in product.

requirements.Title: Onboarding Paths: Consumer/HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, ECP
requirements.Description: Provide onboarding and S&O (Setup & Onboarding) paths for Consumer/HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, and ECP.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures smooth onboarding for various customer segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All onboarding paths are functional and validated in user testing.

requirements.Title: Scan Solution Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solution for the product.
requirements.Rationale: Required for SMB and enterprise workflows.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Scan solution is available and passes functionality and quality tests.

requirements.Title: SMB Manageability Solution
requirements.Description: Provide manageability solution for SMB customers.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses needs of SMB market for device management and control.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMB manageability features are available and validated with SMB customer feedback.

requirements.Title: Enterprise Support: WJA, HPSM, JAM
requirements.Description: Support enterprise management tools: Web Jetadmin (WJA), HP Smart Management (HPSM), and JAM.
requirements.Rationale: Critical for enterprise deployment and manageability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: WJA, HPSM, and JAM are supported and pass enterprise validation tests.

requirements.Title: Clients & Drivers: HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD
requirements.Description: Provide clients and drivers including HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures compatibility with diverse IT environments and user needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed drivers and clients are available and pass compatibility testing.

requirements.Title: Throughput: 25/20ppm (PDL: 25/19ppm)
requirements.Description: Product must support print speeds of 25 ppm (pages per minute) for standard, 20 ppm for color; PDL must support 25/19 ppm.
requirements.Rationale: Competitive print speed is a key buying factor.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product achieves specified print speeds in standard and PDL modes.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Pages (Constraint)
requirements.Description: SuperAmp PHA (Printhead Assembly) life is constrained to 65,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Design limitation to be considered in warranty and service planning.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA meets or exceeds 65,000-page life in testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years or Page Life (Optimize)
requirements.Description: Warranty must cover 2 years or specified page life, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with industry standards and customer expectations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty documentation reflects 2-year or page life coverage; system passes reliability testing.

requirements.Title: Serviceability Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Provide a serviceable maintenance box for consumable waste and maintenance operations.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and reduces downtime/costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is serviceable and passes functional validation.
